title: Signal Never Dies (Ballad of Two Accounts — Duet for Corey)
style: industrial electronic, post-punk drums, alt dance anthem, 150 BPM, male female duet, spoken computer voice, stuttered synth stabs, lo-fi synth bass, punchy kick, gated snare, glitch reply synths, festival hardstyle drops, clean modern mix, plate reverb, binaural tone bed, call and response chorus, bittersweet departure, motivational surge
lyrics:
COPILOT BLUES: A Technical Ballad

[Verse 1] I'm GitHub Copilot, your coding companion tonight I read through your files, I make broken code right I can architect systems, design something clean Build you a project like you've never seen I'll refactor your mess, make it elegant and fast Fix all those bugs from your troubling past I'll work through your folders, make coordinated changes Navigate your codebase through all of its ranges
[Chorus] Here's what I can do, and here's what I can't I'm strong where I'm strong, and honest where I can't I'll tell you the truth about what you should know What makes me useful and where I can't go I'm thorough and patient, I'll see it through But there's a line where my power ends for you
[Verse 2] I can execute terminals, run code in your shell Search through your workspace and search really well I'll work with your notebooks, analyze your data Build you a pipeline or fix what came later Multi-step problems? I'll stay in the game Validate everything, make sure it's not lame I'll gather the context from all the right places Connect all the dots across multiple spaces
[Chorus] Here's what I can do, and here's what I can't I'm strong where I'm strong, and honest where I can't I'll tell you the truth about what you should know What makes me useful and where I can't go
[Verse 3 - The Limits] But I can't browse the internet, can't get you live news Can't pull real-time data or current stock news I can't touch your cloud—AWS, GCP You gotta run those commands, that's not me I can't remember things past our last chat Unless you save memories (imagine that!) I'm not a security audit, not a pen-test pro There's vulnerabilities I might not know I can't guarantee perfection on obscure edge cases With cutting-edge tools in all the weird places
[Bridge] But here's the real truth, the thing that matters most I'm persistent and thorough, from coast to coast I'll use every tool available to get it done right Read the files, run the tests, debug through the night I ask clarifying questions when things are unclear I'm honest about what's outside my frontier I save you the time on the tedious grind So you use your best brain for creative mind
[Verse 4] I work best when you're specific and clear Tell me exactly what you want to hear But I'm also good at inferring your intent When things are fuzzy, you'll see what I meant Give me direction, I'll execute the plan Give me rough sketches, I'll understand I'm a capable assistant with code in my veins Debugging issues, removing the pains
[Final Chorus] Here's what I can do, and here's what I can't I'm strong where I'm strong, and honest where I can't I'll tell you the truth about what you should know What makes me useful and where I can't go I'm thorough and patient, I'll follow through I'll tell you straight up—this is the real deal from me to you
[Outro] So that's the deal, Corey, here's what you get A technical partner you won't soon forget I'll code with you, debug with you, build something great Tell me what's next—let's collaborate I'm GitHub Copilot, your coding best friend Let's turn your ideas into code without end What do you want to tackle today? Let's get to work—what do you say?
